question: Does the J8V positive pairwise second-public-law contrast extend across the complete structural class of equal-prior three-edge first-flux collisions whose canonical base has deterministic all-zero-charge first record, or is direct operator-law heterogeneity an obstruction to pooling?
fork_classification: The 12 deterministic-base collision sectors are independent reversible diagnostic branches. Their complete 24-error/two-action direct matrix is under the existing 60-CPU-second and 65,536-term caps, so run all 12 without a human ranking. This direct class census is a prerequisite to an operator-law symmetry reduction; equality would not itself prove a global automorphism.
frozen_model: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 projector orbit, 36 IID red-X edges at p_X=1/10 and p_Z=0. Signal-only pre-action full 24-site binary flux/charge/vacuum first record uses each sector's shared first flux, all charge zero, vacuum=1-charge. Two relation-free fixed public charge actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35] bind the full second public flux/charge/vacuum record. Private error support is never visible to the action.

hypotheses.homogeneous_direct_class: All positive-first-mass pairs have the same two-action exact second-law TV pattern as the frozen J8V deterministic-first pair; this is only a necessary diagnostic for a reduction, not a symmetry proof.
hypotheses.heterogeneous_direct_class: At least one sector has a different paired TV pattern or first-record exclusion; naive structural pooling across this class is falsified.
hypotheses.censored: Any geometry, source, replay, Born, commutation, action-binding, normalization, term or CPU gate fails; no partial class claim is promoted.

matrix.sector_selection: Enumerate all 7,140 three-edge supports; retain every first-flux sector with exactly two supports and J8U canonical-base all-zero-charge first likelihood 1. Sort by integer flux mask. Exactly 12 sectors are expected; freeze both equal-prior supports in each, no adaptive replacement.
matrix.cells: Twelve sectors times two private three-edge errors times two fixed public actions. Evaluate both complete first likelihoods and every positive-first-mass complete conditional second public law; report exact pair TV per action or undefined on first-record exclusion.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact private-error/complete-first-record/public-action cell; exact rationals, no stochastic uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin runner and all source/result inputs; reconstruct 120 double-support sectors and all 12 deterministic-base sectors, replay frozen J8V selected deterministic row, check direct ordered-projector first mass, independent direct second moment per positive cell, eligible-site/commutation/action-binding/normalization gates, term and CPU caps, source stability and zero histories/arms/bootstraps.

acceptance: All 12 prospectively defined sectors have two independently checked complete first likelihoods
Every positive-first-mass error/action cell has normalized complete second public law and a direct second-moment replay
All paired fixed-action TVs or exclusions are reported and the prior J8V deterministic row is reproduced
Report only finite class heterogeneity or homogeneity, not operator automorphism, full-IID information/risk, noisy JIT or threshold
stop_rule: Stop after all 12 sectors or first integrity/65,536-term/60-CPU-second cap. Do not add sectors, change public actions or first records, expand budget, run histories or infer symmetry from matching patterns.
